text:
mei (design): quick design check 10026: compact timeline + rollback CTA. I pushed 2 comps to Figma. looking for accessibility/wording feedback.
rafa (product): thanks! main ask: make rollback safe & discoverable. there0s confusion between 'Rollback' and 'Revert' in older notes. prefer softer language for customers.
mei (design): thinking: primary CTA = 'Rollback' (short), helper tooltip explains effect. toast will say 'Reverted to snapshot v3 1 Undo'.
samir (a11y): prefer consistent language. pick 'Revert' across UI. tooltip text should be exposed via aria-describedby. toast must be focusable and have role="alertdialog" if we move focus.
zoe (eng): implementation note: we can focus toast only if action was keyboard-initiated. otherwise leave focus where it is. also debounce live metric updates while inspector open to avoid focus jumps.
mei (design): compact timeline: when collapsed show 'Show full timeline' button that is keyboard tabbable. also increased hit targets on slider ticks.
rafa (product): nudge amounts: Shift+Arrow = 1%, Arrow = 5%. but add confirmation modal if delta >20%.
samir (a11y): modal must trap focus and be labelled. provide an aria-live announcement when change applied: 'Reverted to snapshot v3; traffic routed to this snapshot. Undo available in banner or Version History.'
zoe (eng): estimate: 3 dev days for keyboard handlers + toast + debounce + modal.
mei (design): action items: 1) update comps to use 'Revert' 2) samir to paste aria copy 3) zoe to prototype. will schedule a 15m keyboard-only usability next week.
